newsitem.title: FRANCE: Balladur sees no ground for franc devaluation.
newsitem.headline: Balladur sees no ground for franc devaluation.

text.p: Former prime minister Edouard Balladur said in a newspaper interview that nothing justified a devaluation of the franc against the mark.

"The franc-mark parity is a good one, which reflects the economic and financial reality...Nothing justifies devaluing the franc against the mark," Balladur said in an interview to be published by Le Figaro in its Friday edition.

The focus should be on correcting the under-valuation of the dollar, he said, calling on France and Germany to start talking with the United States on ways to "correct the under-valuation of the dollar."

Balladur, who lost to Jacques Chirac in the last presidential elections, explained that the parity of the future euro single currency against the dollar hinged for a large part on the current value of the franc-mark couple against the dollar.
"That value is too high because the dollar is undervalued," he said.
